messages:
Tara (CS): Heads-up  Orchid Analytics onboarding: completion rate on their insights-bot flow slipped ~14% in the past 36h. Renewal check in ~3 weeks. I want to propose a cautious pilot: route low-complexity intents to a compact quantized model and keep complex/escalation intents on current model. Thoughts? :triage_flag:
Ethan (Eng): I pulled traces. Latency and cost spike when context > 600 tokens. Quick window:
```
p50: 230ms
p95: 810ms
avg_tokens: 610
```
Ethan (Eng): Ops plan: use complexity_score (0-1) computed by preprocessor. If complexity_score < 0.35 -> candidate route. We can ramp 1% -> 5% -> 15% with checks at each step and immediate fallback on any quality signal.
Rhea (ML): Model eval: rdx-econ-int8 candidate shows small drop on our Orchid prompt rubric (~0.5% acceptability). Hallucination rate unchanged. Recommend: prefix cache for templates, token_budget fallback (if generation >750 tokens -> fallback to full model), and nightly sampled human checks (4/day).
Rhea (ML): Proposed gates:
- Canary: rdx-econ-int8, 4% traffic, 72h
- Nightly eval: acceptability, rouge_delta, hallucination_rate
- Auto-rollback if nightly_acceptability_drop > 1% OR escalations increase >10% over baseline for 24h
canary-bot: Pilot scheduled: https://internal.redwood/pilot/orchid-econ-int8 (internal)
Ethan (Eng): Routing pseudo-config draft:
```
routing:
  - match: complexity_score < 0.35 AND tag != escalation
    target: rdx-econ-int8
  - match: else
    target: rdx-standard-2
  - fallback: rdx-standard-2
  - logging: store pre/post outputs for canary requests
```
Tara (CS): I'll prepare a short customer note explaining protections and the rollback plan. Can someone paste a 1-line tech blurb I can copy? :memo:
Rhea (ML): Blurb: "We're running a monitored pilot that routes low-complexity bot requests to a compact quantized variant to stabilize latency and lower cost; critical and complex requests will remain on the current model and all changes are auto-gated by nightly quality checks and human spot-checks."
Ethan (Eng): I'll hook up the audit logs and PD alert on rollback. Also enabling a soft-opt-out flag so Orchid can opt particular flows out from their side.
Tara (CS): Owners: @Rhea owns evals and spot-checks, @Ethan owns routing + rollback automation, I own customer comms and renewal note. I'll add a row in the renewal tracker and schedule a 20-min sync with Orchid ops for tomorrow 9am PT. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
